reviews.t: This came in a very bad package. The product is not a shell as ...
reviews.x: This came in a very bad package. The product is not a shell as shown in the picture but a rectangle silver box. One piece of paper printout with any manual. The box does not open and close well. There are only 10 pieces of stones included not 12 as they claimed. Very disappointed.

reviews.t: Much better than a water based stone warmer
reviews.x: I bought this in summer time to decrease the temp in my massage room. Even with the ac cranked the excess heat from the hot stone warmer filled with water in my room was cooking me. This stone warmer heats up in about 20-25 minutes, stays consistently warm and even after 8 hours the stones aren’t too hot to touch. If you are a massage therapist and on the fence about this, treat yourself to this clamshell. Honestly one of my favorite tools I’ve purchased so far.

I like this clamshell but there are better options out there.  I give a lot of hot rock massages.  Start with some oil to loosen up the body, then use the hot rocks, then massage again after.  My last set looked almost like a crock pot.  You filled it with water, put the rocks in (of which, there were many different shapes and sizes), let them get to a temperature that the person being massaged liked, and you took them out and put them on their body.  The problem here is, there's no water.  Ther

The stones are extremely uniform in shape and heat up fairly evenly. Takes about 20 minutes or so to heat up. This is not a heavy duty unit , so you need to just be careful and only move the unit WITHOUT the stones in it. Put the stones in a bag when traveling.  I like it. Seems very convenient to bring to other locations for a spot treatment. Just note that after you use the stones, place in a bowl to be washed after. I would not recommend putting stones back in unit to 're-heat' like you do wi

It's bigger than I thought and really nice. The warmer is great beats stones fast, no water needed, the rocks are soft and feel good on the body my clients love it and it's easy to transport if you are doing house calls!

reviews.t: ... got this for me for valentines day and I LOVE IT so much
reviews.x: my boyfriend got this for me for valentines day and I LOVE IT so much! I have to sit alot for studying, and my back/neck hurt all the time. I love using these to massage my eyes & neck! It was meant for nice massage, but I ended up using it more than just that. I use it as a heat pad, feet warmer, soothing the eyes from looking at computer screens all day.  I'm so glad he bought this for me!

The heater was great the few times I was able to use it. It was a perfect temperature and the rocks are fabricated to a perfect shape. But it only lasted 3 weeks! I was sent a replacement but I had to pay $21 for shipping. Then the new one stopped working the 3rd time I used it. Very disappointing! This heater is poorly made and it was past its very short warranty period so I lost over $100!

As I was very skeptical at first, I must say I am very pleased with this! The stones are perfectly sized, the shell heats quickly, and I clean it with sanitizing wipes after each use. The stones are lightweight and easy to clean under water and soap. The cord is plenty long enough and thick, not cheap feeling at all. The switch on the back lights up when switched to the on position, so it's easy to see of it's on in a dimly lit room during a massage session. Even with all stones in the shell, it

reviews.t: ... bit more secure but other than that I really love this set
reviews.x: I just wish the closing mechanicism was a little bit more secure but other than that I really love this set. Clean up is easy too. I use the stones as I go and put them back on the heater in between. Easy clean up with soap and water for the stones then I use rubbing alcohol to clean the unit.

reviews.t: If you are a massage therapist, buy this now!!!
reviews.x: I can't tell you how happy I am with this purchase. I am a CMT and I used to hate giving heated stone. This purchased changed that! It heats up to my ideal temperature within 20 minutes, is easy clean up, and provides a smooth and time efficient massage! Love it! I ordered a second one so I will never have to use my "turkey roaster" again! Two sets will be enough for a full service heated stone massage. Love it! Definitely worth the money!

Do not by this product! Quit working after one use, company will not accept return because it is after my 30 day return period. Thought this would be perfect for mobile massage, don't waste your money.

I love this product! It heats the stones quickly to the perfect temperature & I don't have to worry about cleaning out large bins of water like with previous hot stone heaters I've had. I actually ordered two sets so I can have the preferred amount of stones for a full body hot stone massage session.
Very practical, heats up fast, I love the size.

reviews.t: This is awesome! I bought it for girls night in with ...
reviews.x: This is awesome! I bought it for girls night in with adult daughters-in-law. It was great for a movie and spa night. It heats up fast, the stones are smooth and heat really quick and retain the heat. We just popped them back on when the cooled and by the time we were ready to switch the stone out again so where the stones.

reviews.t: Great for home use and a few clients
reviews.x: I love that it heats up fast, (10 mins). The rocks are very uniform in shape and thickness, and the rocks hold their heat like any other basalt stone. Very nice for home use and if you only have a client or two. However if you are planning to use them alot and multiple times a day I feel that 12 rocks isn't enough.

If you enjoy essential oils this set is a lovely addition. I also incorporate them into my yin yoga practice . I just lay them where my body hurts while in the pose.  It's like being able to have a little heating pad anywhere you want it.  Simply Beautiful !
Super nice addition to our spa. I still need to use them on my wife, but am sure they will be great. Takes about 15-20 minutes to get hot, so just plan ahead and you will love this set.

reviews.t: Perfect for Massage Therapists who do home or hotel massages ...
reviews.x: Perfect for Massage Therapists who do home or hotel massages and want to be able to offer a hot stone massage.

I love this warmer.  The stones are smaller than I expected.  The "large" ones I would actually consider medium and the small ones "tiny."  Haha...The small ones are about an inch and a half in diameter.  Maybe the description has exact measurements but I was just surprised.  I still LOVE them though.  It heats up relatively fast and heats the stones to the PERFECT temperature.  JUST PERFECT!!!!!  Not hot enough to feel like they are burning my hands but hot enough to have to con

reviews.t: the unit itself is good. It heats and works well
reviews.x: So to start, the unit itself is good. It heats and works well. The stones on the other hand are crap. They heat up quick, and quick to cool and get way too hot without retaining any heat.. Not for Professional. They are like garden stones you can find anywhere. Wish it would give you nice stones for the price :( Going to have to buy a set of basalt stones that will fit this, so that I can have a professional set for hot stone massage.

reviews.t: with only needing a very short cool off time before using them on a client
reviews.x: I've used these once so far, but I'm impressed! The rocks heat up to just the right temperature, with only needing a very short cool off time before using them on a client. The stones are just the right size for my hands, and very well polished. The size of the clam shell is just right, not too big or too small. Perfect to place on a side table in my massage room. Overall, I'm very pleased with this purchase!

Absolutely fabulous! I run a mobile massage business and recently added hot stones to my list of services and my clients absolutely love them! Nice size stones and they hold heat well and for a good length of time.. Heats completely in about 10 minutes..Nice variety of sizes and quantity..Nice to be able to have a travel set of stones...Worth every penny and some!

These are the very best! My husband has lower back pain & I have neck pain. Yes...we are OLD, but these stones are miracles! I just put a couple in a satin glasses case & massage away...absolutely marvelous! These were delivered quickly, too! I gave it to my husband for Valentine's Day!

This hot stone heater is pretty cute, but also functional.  It does look like a clamshell and it is a nice size.  The hot stones heated within 15 minutes and evenly.  I've only used them once so far as I just received them, but I like them.  Good purchase.
Was sent the wrong item. I contacted the seller and easy peasy it was corrected! Ill never go back to using water in a roasting pan with my hot stones again! I love these stones and heater

claims.text: Many reviewers praise how quickly the warmer heats up, often citing around 10-25 minutes.
Reviewers frequently highlight that no water is needed, unlike previous water-based warmers.
Several reviewers report durability problems, with units failing after only a few uses or weeks.
Multiple reviewers note the stones are uniform in shape and size and hold heat well.
Some reviewers complain about packaging and build quality issues, including the box not opening/closing well and a less secure closing mechanism.
